sentences.text: MOR is a cohort company whose country is recorded as SE, and the sources we read hold no register entry for it.
The record shows five exhibitor or demo entries between 2024-10-31 and 2026-09-29, all from garvemor.se.
It also shows first customer or pilot and programme-entry records for 2026 with the year only, both at low confidence.
A programme-entry record on the apelago.fi site is dated 2026-02-09.
No funding or contract record is on file, so every readiness level is unknown.
For the fund this stays on the watchlist, and the pilot record should be checked at its source.
